about: Keeps count of the water you drink and reminds you when it is time for a glass. The widget shows today's progress as a water level with gentle waves, and you log a drink with one tap on a preset amount.
highlights: Animated water level in the dashboard carousel
One tap logs a glass: four presets you can change
A reminder when you have gone too long without drinking
Daily goal and reminder interval are yours to set
author: iMacnucintosh

changes: Lists the data it leaves behind, so removing it can delete it too
First release in the hub (it used to ship with the shell)
